purpose: M3 corpus of published Edison tournament lists for a held-out split. Placements, not a strength ranking.
privacy: No player names, handles, Discord ids or user ids. Raw responses stay in build/edison-corpus/raw/.

definitions.distinct list: Main, Extra and Side identical as multisets of passcodes; every source appearance is kept
definitions.list_id: fl + the lowest training deck id, else the lowest deck id among the appearances; the .ydk uses that appearance's card order
definitions.archetype: the source's deckTypeName, casefolded, '&' to 'and', punctuation dropped, words joined by '_'; nothing merged by meaning
definitions.production_legal: the file alone passes the unmodified production init_module with the audit's full code list (validate_gauntlet.py path)
definitions.outside_v1: cards in any zone absent from tools/edison/learner/codes_v1.txt
definitions.gottoms_rule: decks.py registry(): drop cards outside the legal pool and XX-Saber Gottoms (OUTSIDE_V1), play the rest
definitions.inside_v1_main_extra: production legal, and after the Gottoms rule every Main and Extra card is in code list v1; what today's networks can load. The env stores only Main and Extra
definitions.inside_v1_side: after the Gottoms rule every Side card is in v1; matters only for siding
definitions.inside_v1_strict: production legal and no card in any zone outside v1, with nothing removed
definitions.untrained_main_extra: after the Gottoms rule, Main and Extra cards found in no Main or Extra of the 21 registry() training lists; v1 tokens and closure cards (v1 codes in no zone of those lists) count as trained, a card seen only in a training Side does not
definitions.nearest_training: registry() training list with the fewest Main+Extra card differences after the Gottoms rule, counted with multiplicity as the sum of per-passcode count differences; ties go to the lowest sorted name
definitions.in_training: an appearance has one of the 18 gauntlet deck ids, or the list is identical to a gauntlet source or fixture
